tx:
▸ Fletching
Broad-tipped bolts can be made using the Fletching skill of at least level 55 by adding feathers to unfinished broad bolts after purchasing the ability to fletch them for 300 Slayer points. Unfinished broad bolts can be purchased from Slayer Masters with coins, and they are also available from monster drops and can be purchased on the Grand Exchange.
Broad-tipped bolts are fletched 10 at a time and give 3 Fletching experience per bolt, or 30 experience per set of 10 bolts made.
▸ Requirements
Broad-tipped bolts are only usable by players with a Slayer level of at least 55 and a Ranged level of at least 50. They may be fired by any crossbow, with the exception of Karil's crossbow and its pistol and off-hand pistol variants, which can only fire bolt racks.
▸ Usefulness
Many people use broad-tipped bolts for training and general ranging because they are as strong as rune bolts but significantly cheaper.
